import json
import os
import sys
from importlib.metadata import version as package_version

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import pydeseq2
from pydeseq2.dds import DeseqDataSet
from pydeseq2.ds import DeseqStats

counts_path, layout_path, mapping_path = sys.argv[1:4]
related_groups = [
    "DMSO",
    "DMSO_Serum_starvation",
    "Cisplatin_IC50_CBD_IC50",
    "Cisplatin_IC50_CBD_IC50_Serum_starvation_16h",
]
reference_group = "DMSO"
target_group = "Cisplatin_IC50_CBD_IC50"

counts = pd.read_csv(counts_path, index_col=0)
counts.index = counts.index.astype(str).str.strip().str.replace(r"\.\d+$", "", regex=True)
counts.columns = [str(c).strip().replace("_", "-") for c in counts.columns]
if counts.index.has_duplicates:
    raise ValueError("Duplicate gene identifiers in counts matrix")
if len(set(counts.columns)) != len(counts.columns):
    raise ValueError("Duplicate sample identifiers after normalization")
counts = counts.apply(pd.to_numeric, errors="raise")
if (counts < 0).any().any():
    raise ValueError("Negative count detected")
if not np.all(np.equal(counts.to_numpy(), np.floor(counts.to_numpy()))):
    raise ValueError("Non-integer count detected")
counts = counts.astype("int64")

layout = pd.read_csv(layout_path, dtype=str)
required_layout = {"SampleID", "Group"}
if not required_layout.issubset(layout.columns):
    raise ValueError("Sample layout is missing SampleID or Group")
layout["SampleID"] = layout["SampleID"].astype(str).str.strip().str.replace("_", "-", regex=False)
layout["Group"] = layout["Group"].astype(str).str.strip()
if layout["SampleID"].duplicated().any():
    raise ValueError("Duplicate SampleID in sample layout")
layout = layout.set_index("SampleID")
if set(counts.columns) != set(layout.index):
    missing_in_layout = sorted(set(counts.columns) - set(layout.index))
    missing_in_counts = sorted(set(layout.index) - set(counts.columns))
    raise ValueError(f"Sample mismatch: missing_in_layout={missing_in_layout}; missing_in_counts={missing_in_counts}")
layout = layout.loc[counts.columns]

prefilter_mask = (counts > 10).any(axis=1)
counts_prefiltered = counts.loc[prefilter_mask].copy()

fit_samples = [s for s in counts_prefiltered.columns if layout.loc[s, "Group"] in related_groups]
if len(fit_samples) != 12:
    raise ValueError(f"Expected 12 samples in the four related groups, found {len(fit_samples)}")
fit_meta = layout.loc[fit_samples, ["Group"]].copy()
fit_meta["Group"] = pd.Categorical(fit_meta["Group"], categories=related_groups, ordered=True)
fit_counts = counts_prefiltered.loc[:, fit_samples].T
fit_counts.index = fit_meta.index
fit_counts = fit_counts.astype("int64")

try:
    dds = DeseqDataSet(
        counts=fit_counts,
        metadata=fit_meta,
        design="~Group",
        refit_cooks=True,
        n_cpus=max(1, int(os.environ.get("GALAXY_SLOTS", "1"))),
    )
except TypeError:
    dds = DeseqDataSet(
        counts=fit_counts,
        metadata=fit_meta,
        design_factors="Group",
        refit_cooks=True,
        n_cpus=max(1, int(os.environ.get("GALAXY_SLOTS", "1"))),
    )
dds.deseq2()
stat_res = DeseqStats(
    dds,
    contrast=["Group", target_group, reference_group],
    alpha=0.05,
    n_cpus=max(1, int(os.environ.get("GALAXY_SLOTS", "1"))),
)
stat_res.summary()
res = stat_res.results_df.copy()
res.index = res.index.astype(str)
res.index.name = "gene_id"
res = res.reset_index()

mapping = pd.read_csv(mapping_path, sep="\t", dtype=str)
mapping.columns = [str(c).strip() for c in mapping.columns]
if not {"ENSG", "gene_name"}.issubset(mapping.columns):
    raise ValueError("Mapping table must contain ENSG and gene_name columns")
mapping["ENSG"] = mapping["ENSG"].astype(str).str.strip().str.replace(r"\.\d+$", "", regex=True)
mapping["gene_name"] = mapping["gene_name"].astype(str).str.strip()
mapping = mapping.loc[mapping["ENSG"].ne("") & mapping["gene_name"].ne("") & mapping["gene_name"].ne("nan")]
conflicting = mapping.groupby("ENSG", sort=False)["gene_name"].nunique()
if (conflicting > 1).any():
    raise ValueError("Mapping table has conflicting gene names for an ENSG")
mapping = mapping.drop_duplicates(subset=["ENSG"], keep="first")
gene_map = mapping.set_index("ENSG")["gene_name"]
res["gene_name"] = res["gene_id"].map(gene_map)
res["baseMean"] = pd.to_numeric(res["baseMean"], errors="coerce")
res["log2FoldChange"] = pd.to_numeric(res["log2FoldChange"], errors="coerce")
res["padj"] = pd.to_numeric(res["padj"], errors="coerce")
res["foreground"] = (
    res["padj"].le(0.05)
    & res["log2FoldChange"].abs().ge(0.5)
    & res["baseMean"].ge(10)
    & res["gene_name"].notna()
    & res["gene_name"].ne("")
)
foreground = sorted(set(res.loc[res["foreground"], "gene_name"].astype(str)))
background = sorted(set(counts_prefiltered.index.astype(str).map(gene_map).dropna().astype(str)))
res["mapped_gene_name"] = res["gene_name"].notna()
res.to_csv("de_results.tsv", sep="\t", index=False)
counts_prefiltered.to_csv("filtered_counts.tsv", sep="\t", index=True)
with open("foreground.txt", "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
    if foreground:
        handle.write("\n".join(foreground) + "\n")
with open("background.txt", "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
    if background:
        handle.write("\n".join(background) + "\n")
metadata = {
    "method": "PyDESeq2",
    "pydeseq2_version": getattr(pydeseq2, "__version__", package_version("pydeseq2")),
    "count_matrix_samples": int(counts.shape[1]),
    "count_matrix_genes": int(counts.shape[0]),
    "prefilter_rule": "count > 10 in at least one of all 30 samples",
    "prefiltered_gene_count": int(counts_prefiltered.shape[0]),
    "fit_groups": related_groups,
    "fit_sample_count": int(len(fit_samples)),
    "fit_sample_ids": fit_samples,
    "contrast_factor": "Group",
    "contrast_target": target_group,
    "contrast_reference": reference_group,
    "alpha": 0.05,
    "foreground_rule": "padj <= 0.05 and abs(log2FoldChange) >= 0.5 and baseMean >= 10",
    "foreground_gene_name_count": int(len(foreground)),
    "background_gene_name_count": int(len(background)),
    "unmapped_prefiltered_ensg_count": int(counts_prefiltered.index.map(gene_map).isna().sum()),
}
with open("run_metadata.json", "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
    json.dump(metadata, handle, indent=2, sort_keys=True)
